description: Type definitions for internal identifier comparison functions used in the semver package. Provides utility functions for comparing version identifiers which are strings or nullable values.

methods.name: export function compareIdentifiers(a: string | null | undefined, b: string | null | undefined): / compareIdentifiers
methods.description: Compares two identifiers, must be numeric strings or truthy/falsy values. Sorts in ascending order for Array.sort().

methods.name: rcompareIdentifiers
methods.description: The reverse of compareIdentifiers. Sorts in descending order for Array.sort().
